ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The pharaoh who ruled Egypt for two decades and built like a king.
The last Ptolemy, who played Rome's strongmen against each other for twenty years.
The Iceni queen whose revolt burned Roman London.
The queen of Palmyra who carved an empire from Rome's east.
The only woman to rule China as emperor in her own name.
Korea's first reigning queen, patron of scholars and stargazers.
The queen who fought and out-bargained the Portuguese for forty years.
Gloriana: the unmarried queen who made a weak realm a power.
The empress who seized a throne and an age and gave Russia both.
